usedFor: Givebutter takes donations and Airtable keeps your records, so “New Transaction” in Givebutter adds a row through “Create Record”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Transaction” in Givebutter, then “Create Record” in Airtable
bestTemplate.why: Every new gift lands as a row in your base the moment Givebutter reports it.

watchOut: “Record Created Or Updated” in Airtable is polling and fires on edits too, so one record can reach Givebutter twice.
